summary: Iteration-7: reliability-first phase closure. (a) Fixed metrics.py cumulative other-cost allocation is verified by NEW iter7 tests that invoke the REAL portal.metrics.sales() (via monkeypatched sale_query to isolate to a single order id) - not by copying formulas. All 5 iter7 cases PASS strictly: two-equal-line/1-paise other-cost reconciles exactly (sum(products.profit_minor) == snap.estimated_gross_profit_minor and no product profit is None), repeated product yields orders=1 with aggregated units, zero-rate rule + ledger adjustment 0->500 is reflected in report totals while snapshot stays immutable, historical missing-cost order returns profit_minor=None and cost_known=False through the real function, tiny other-cost 4-line order never produces negative product profit share. (b) iter6's copied-formula assertion was REPLACED with a real metrics.sales() invocation and now PASSES. (c) iter5 dead 'if False' block, default MongoDB URL/DB and hardcoded reseller password literals removed; iter5 payout test now creates its own scoped rule + costs and asserts commission earned instead of pytest.skip. (d) All iter5+iter6+iter7 = 19 tests PASS serially under -o addopts= (avoiding pytest.ini -n 2 that would race). (e) Cleanup script inspected, regex extended to include QA_ITER7 (was 4/5/6). Dry-run captured 397 records + baseline; --apply archived+removed 397 records; iter7-run added another 82 records archived+removed. Post-apply dry-run yields 0.
